events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Favourites
angles.copy: From the gadgets to the villains, and of course, those iconic theme tunes – what's your all-time favourite James Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide. What's your go-to Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique brand of humour is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Tracks
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' was released 58 years ago today! A double album packed with classics. Which track is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting left an indelible mark on music. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and showcased their evolving sound. Which track still stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was shot in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Peace
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a voice for peace and a musical visionary whose impact continues to be felt around the world.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The influential British singer, songwriter, and actor David Bowie was born in London in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, was born in Tupelo, Mississippi, in 1935.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. His music and charisma changed the world. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page was born in Heston, Middlesex, in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's greatest guitarists. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer known for his distinctive raspy voice, was born in Highgate, London, in 1945.

angles.name: Maggie May & More
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! From Faces to his incredible solo career, his songs are timeless. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, was born in Hastings, England, in 1961.

angles.name: Madness Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness brought us so many unforgettable tunes. Which Madness song is your favourite?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his soulful voice and 80s hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', was born in Luton in 1956.

angles.name: Soulful Sounds
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a generation. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary American country music singer, songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton was born in Sevier County, Tennessee, in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly's World
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon whose talent and generosity are as big as her hair. What's your favourite Dolly song or movie?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow was born in Frodsham, Cheshire, in 1971.

angles.name: Take That & Beyond
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That's biggest hits to his successful solo career, he's a true pop maestro. What's your favourite Gary Barlow penned track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, was born in Fyzabad, Trinidad and Tobago, in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! His smooth vocals gave us some of the biggest hits of the 80s. What's your favourite Billy Ocean song?
